name: Webarchive (Wayback Machine)
description: Find an existing accessible snapshot using the Wayback Availability API.
features: Accept url, link, domain and hostname attributes using the misp_standard format. Domains and hostnames query http://<value>/; this is a root URL lookup, not a search of all archived pages on the domain.

Without timestamp, retrieve the most recent accessible snapshot returned by the API. With timestamp, retrieve the closest snapshot; it may be before or after the requested date. Only an available snapshot with HTTP status 200 produces an object.

Return a page-capture object containing url (queried URL), archive (snapshot link) and capture-date (actual snapshot time in UTC). Preserve the original attribute and reference its UUID with related-to. Generated attributes have to_ids=false.
Reuse the upstream page-capture template, bundled for compatibility with PyMISP releases that do not include it yet. Import/update this standard template in MISP if your server does not have it.
No API key or new archive submission is required. Only metadata is queried; the module does not contact the original site or download archived page contents. Each API request has a 15-second timeout.
Missing or inaccessible snapshots return an explanatory error without an object. HTTP failures, timeouts, malformed JSON and invalid snapshot metadata also return errors.

config.timestamp: Optional string of 1-14 digits (YYYYMMDDhhmmss), for example 20060101. Omit or leave empty for the latest accessible snapshot.
